title: Collection-Item Boundary Envy (Date Range Filtering)
pattern: A method checks if an item falls within bounds by repeatedly querying the item's properties and comparing them against locally-scoped variables representing the range.
why_bad: The logic of "checking if a date falls within a range" is duplicated and coupled. It envies the `DateRange` concept, which should manage its own boundary check invariants.
detection: Loop bodies containing multiple logic gates (`&&`, `||`) checking a single property against start/end parameters.
counterexample: Simple equality checks or simple checks against a single constant value.
